## Role

**Social Media Marketing Intern**, Ontario Jr Reign · Ontario, CA · *June 2024 – March 2025*

## Result

::: {.card-box}
### 📈 273.94% growth
in combined audience following across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X
:::

## How

- **Platform-specific content:** developed and executed posts tailored to each of the four platforms
- **Short-form video:** edited dynamic video in CapCut to maximize viewer engagement
- **Consistent publishing:** managed all channels in Buffer to keep the team visible all season
- **Business impact:** content increased team visibility and supported ticket sales throughout the season

**Tools:** Buffer, CapCut, Canva
